name: ModelVariant751_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant751_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (an orb gathers in front of a model part while its colour fades in, flies across with a cloud of quads and spinning rays, then opens into a growing ring with layered glows and a fountain of falling sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orb offsets, 32 sparks and the 16-point ring and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 while the orb gathers and flies, 1 once it has landed and 2 after the light has recovered and the colour has faded out; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-768 and 865 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
